hotels.title: Serene Yarra Valley Wine Country Retreat with Outdoor Heated Pool & Daily Breakfast
hotels.description: Discover the magic of Victoria’s breathtaking Yarra Valley with a relaxing stay right in the heart of Marysville. Peppers Marysville is perfectly positioned to explore the abundance of highly acclaimed wineries in the sprawling wine region. When you aren't sampling Victoria's finest vintages and innovative drops, the rolling Cathedral Ranges, national parks and alpine wonders await. Peppers Marysville boasts a luxury onsite wellness spa and sauna, as well as Andiamo Restaurant and Bar, cementing the hotel as the perfect spot for an indulgent and blissfully romantic escape. Take the time to soak up serenity with a swim in the long, heated pool that overlooks lush green landscapes, or challenge a loved one to a tennis game on the resort’s scenic grounds.
